fact: A UNESCO IITE and UNESCO HQ mission of 11-15 February 2019 carried out an EMIS needs assessment for the Ministry of Education within the framework of OpenEMIS and set out to design a school integrated management information system (SIMIS), with EMIS development planned over the following 12 months; no system was yet in schools.
title: Mauritius EMIS Support and Monitoring of Education 2030 Agenda
